messages:
Sophie: Opening war-room — Acme reports a sharp spike of 5xx/timeouts on hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~09:20 UTC, customer impact high, filing here.
lee: Looking now, pulling grafana panels for gateway and serving pools. link: https://grafana/redwood/prod/gateway-us-west-2
sre-bot: Alert created: IN-2026-171061 — gateway 5xx threshold breached.
Omar: Gateway logs show a lot of upstream=kv-cache err=\"kv_get_timeout\" and some kg-serving timeouts around 09:22. Sample log: 
```
2026-03-17T09:22:15Z gateway us-west-2 req=abc123 upstream=kv-cache err=kv_get_timeout status=504 latency_ms=30012
```
Devon: Auth proxy errors are present but <1% of traffic; main signal is kv latency.
Sophie: Customer telemetry says ~25-40% of requests failed for a 20m window, their clients started aggressive retries and some saw doubled billing attempts.
support-bot: Linked support ticket HD-91234 and customer notes.
lee: Short-term mitigations to consider: 1) enable model fallback for affected endpoints in us-west-2, 2) relax KV client timeout thresholds, 3) request burst GPU capacity for the dedicated pool, 4) instruct customer on jittered backoff and retry budget. Thoughts?
Omar: I can push a 10% canary to route to the compact model variant and monitor.
Devon: Working on a KV client change (increase connection pool + non-blocking gets) to reduce apparent timeouts. Can deploy canary in 10m.
lee: Autoscaler metrics show we hit the hard node cap at 09:25 (reserved capacity limit). We can request burst but it won't be instantaneous.
Sophie: Proceed with canary fallback + KV canary. Also draft a quick customer message telling them were investigating and ask them to enable exponential backoff with jitter.
Omar: Canary at 10% applied at 09:30 UTC — canary error rate dropped to ~8% for those requests.
Devon: KV client canary pushed to subset of KV nodes at 09:38, initial results show lower p99 kv latency.
lee: Escalated burst capacity to infra; engineer assigned and approval pending (ETA ~12m).
Sophie: Posting interim update to HD-91234 with guidance and link to status page.
support-bot: Customer update posted.
Omar: Expanding fallback routing to 100% for the impacted endpoints at 09:36 — watch for performance regressions.
lee: After fallback expansion overall 5xx rate dropped to ~2.5% by 09:40. Client retry storm subsided.
Devon: Rolling KV fix wider; no regressions observed in canary, promoting to region at 09:46.
sophie: Billing check: finance saw an uptick in small retry charges; opening a billing-assist to avoid double invoices.
lee: Created billing assist ticket BA-2026-412; pausing invoice triggers for affected customers until dedupe confirmed.
Omar: Adding immediate observability items: new kv_get p50/p95/p99 panels, and tagging requests that hit fallback.
Devon: Also adding a circuit-breaker on KV client to fail-fast and prefer fallback routing sooner.
sophie: War-room summary: suspected root cause = KV cache saturation/timeouts in us-west-2 combined with hitting autoscaler hard cap; resulting latency/timeouts caused gateway 504s and customer client retries. Mitigations executed: fallback routing, KV client fix, burst capacity request, customer guidance, billing pause.
lee: Moving to action-item assignment for postmortem. Please own items and set due dates.
Sophie: Action items (owners/due dates):
- A1 (Lee) validate burst capacity request and document pre-approval flow  due 2026-03-18
- A2 (Devon) roll out KV connection-pool fixes to all regions and implement circuit-breaker  due 2026-03-19
- A3 (Omar) add CI checks for fallback correctness + alert when fallback exceeds threshold  due 2026-03-20
- A4 (Sophie) author postmortem draft and customer-facing summary, include billing reconciliation  due 2026-03-18
- A5 (Eng-ops) evaluate autoscaler hard cap behavior and pre-warm strategies  due 2026-03-26
- A6 (Support) confirm billing dedupe and notify customer billing status  due 2026-03-18
lee: I'll take A1 and coordinate with infra.
Devon: I'll schedule KV rollout and update the runbook.
Sophie: Thanks all. Marking incident resolved in channel; follow-up postmortem thread will go to #incidents-postmortems.
sre-bot: Incident IN-2026-171061 marked resolved at 09:52 UTC. Postmortem assigned. :white_check_mark:
